record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.original_question: On the torus T^N with N≥2, does there exist a constant C such that every test function ψ satisfies the Bourgain-Brezis type estimate ||ψ - ∫ψ||_{H^{1/2}+W^{1,1}} ≤ C ||∇ψ||_{H^{-1/2}+L^1}? This is the strengthened estimate needed to derive the H^{1/2}+W^{1,1} phase estimate by the same duality method used for the weaker L^{N/(N-1)} estimate.

evidence.quote: If we try to establish (7.8) by the same method as above we would need to invoke a stronger version of (7.6), namely (7.9) kψ − ∫ ψkH1/2+W1,1 ≤ Ck∇ψkH−1/2+L1 ∀ψ. However such an estimate is still undecided: Open Problem 7.1 ([BoBr]). Does (7.9) hold?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N\geq 2$ and let $\mathbb{T}^N=\mathbb{R}^N/\mathbb{Z}^N$ be the $N$-dimensional torus. For $s\in\mathbb{R}$, denote by $H^s(\mathbb{T}^N)$ the usual $L^2$-based Sobolev space defined via Fourier series, and by $W^{1,1}(\mathbb{T}^N)$ the Sobolev space of integrable functions whose distributional gradient lies in $L^1$. For two Banach spaces $X,Y$ of distributions, define the sum space $X+Y$ with norm
$$\|f\|_{X+Y}=\inf\{\|g\|_X+\|h\|_Y : f=g+h,\ g\in X,\ h\in Y\}.$$
For a vector field $V=(V_1,\dots,V_N)$ with components in $X+Y$, set $\|V\|_{X+Y}=\sum_{j}\|V_j\|_{X+Y}$.

Question: Does there exist a constant $C=C(N)$ such that for every smooth function $\psi:\mathbb{T}^N\to\mathbb{R}$,
$$\Big\|\psi-\int_{\mathbb{T}^N}\psi\Big\|_{H^{1/2}(\mathbb{T}^N)+W^{1,1}(\mathbb{T}^N)} \;\leq\; C\,\|\nabla\psi\|_{H^{-1/2}(\mathbb{T}^N)+L^1(\mathbb{T}^N)}\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: A direct resolution of this specific sum-space inequality on the torus does not appear in the literature found. Related Bourgain–Brezis-type limiting estimates have seen progress (e.g., affirmative answers for Euclidean Lorentz-space analogues for div-curl systems), but the precise torus question with the $H^{1/2}+W^{1,1}$ / $H^{-1/2}+L^1$ pairing appears not to be confirmed solved.

status_evidence.snippet: Surveys limiting Bourgain–Brezis estimates and related open questions.
status_evidence.claim: Related limiting estimates remain a subject of active investigation with partial results.

status_evidence.title: Fractional integration and optimal estimates for elliptic systems
status_evidence.snippet: Provides Euclidean Lorentz-space estimates answering a related Bourgain–Brezis question, noting that the torus case is more subtle.
status_evidence.claim: The precise torus version of related Bourgain–Brezis estimates is not yet settled in the cited work.
